title: Leftover hug charge sits under 1/(ln 3 ln n') by Riemann sums plus occupancy 4
statement: On leftover hug/IET words at the certified reduced base, C_L < 1/(ln 3 ln n'). Proof schema: f decreasing implies C_L ≤ (1 + h m / L)(C_* + 1/m) when every equal bin has occupancy error ≤ h; J ≤ 1 - 2/ln n + 6/(ln n)^2 gives an explicit gap under 1/(ln 3 ln n). At m=250, h=4, L≥50508, ln n≥17 the schema fires. Occupancy ≤ 4 is a 19-row integer census, not a charge DP.
mathematical_domain: Juggler cycle finance / exponent-walk optimal control
tested_range: 19 leftovers at floor 26254995; analytic check L=50508, ln n=17, m=250, h=4; extra hitting at L=19,84,1054,50508,60000,100000
notes: The implication h≤4 ⇒ C_L < 1/(ln 3 ln n) is a human inequality (Riemann + J). The cap h≤4 is computationally verified on the leftovers (max overshoot 3.35). Together the 18 walk-charge kills become DP-free at this floor (margin 1.008 at 50508) and L=176251 still survives (margin 0.143). Period bound unchanged.
